title: Bounce Rally
brief: Top-down road that scrolls upward. Your small car bumps other cars sideways off the road into rocks and ditches for points. Press jump to hop over gaps, rivers and broken bridges, and land on enemy cars to crush them. Land in water and you lose a life. Each level gets longer gaps and tougher cars that bump back.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Grid Sprint
brief: Racing seen from just behind your car, road curving toward a horizon. First a timed qualifying lap sets your start place, then a race against 7 rivals with a checkpoint timer. Hitting roadside signs spins you out. Shift between low and high gear; high is fast but slow to recover after a crash.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Interceptor Run
brief: Top-down highway, scrolling up. You drive an armed agent car. Shoot or ram the enemy cars (blade wheels, armored trucks, a helicopter dropping bombs) but never hit the plain civilian cars or you lose points. Drive into the back of a supply truck to get a new weapon: oil slick, smoke screen, missiles. Where the road ends at the water the car becomes a boat.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Block City Hustle
brief: Top-down open city of streets, blocks and a park. Walk, take any car, and take jobs from ringing phone booths: deliver a package, chase a target, race across town in time. Causing trouble raises a heat meter of 1 to 5 stars and more patrol cars chase you; a paint shop clears it. Cartoon tone, no blood.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Squad Buggy
brief: Third-person armored buggy on open hills. You steer; three soldier passengers ride along and shoot by themselves at the nearest enemy in range, and one stands at a mounted gun. Bumps can throw a soldier off; stop beside him to pick him up. Drive the squad to each flag, they hop out and hold it for 20 seconds while you circle and guard them.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Crater Crawler
brief: Side-scrolling six-wheel moon rover. Jump over craters and boulders, shoot forward at rocks and upward at saucers that drop bombs which make new craters. The course is split into lettered checkpoints A to Z with a time for each section.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Neon Drift Wastes
brief: Casual endless runner in a vaporwave cyber wasteland: pink and teal sunset, wireframe grid ground, broken statues, palm-tree antennas, floating glitch cubes. Your hover car slides between 3 lanes and jumps. Pick up data cassettes for score, dodge static walls and falling chrome pillars. Speed rises slowly; a "chill" pickup slows time. No enemies, just the drive and the colors.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Ramp Rider
brief: Side view dirt bike race against 3 riders over ramps and mud. Tilt the bike in the air to land flat; land badly and you tumble. Holding turbo heats the engine; overheat and you stop to cool down.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Fuel Line
brief: Top-down highway race against a fuel gauge, not a clock. Fuel only drops; grab fuel cans that sit between traffic. Some cars swerve into your lane on purpose; oil spots make you spin. Reach the finish before the tank is empty.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Tabletop Racers
brief: Tiny toy cars racing over a giant kitchen table, a desk and a bathtub edge, seen from above. Crumbs, pencils and spilled juice are the obstacles. Fall off the edge and you lose seconds. Pull too far ahead of a rival and they are out of the round.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Coast Road
brief: Racing seen from behind a convertible on a sunny coast road. At the end of each stage the road forks left (easier) or right (harder), so every run is a different route of 5 stages. Traffic, trucks and a time bonus at every checkpoint.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Wreck Ring
brief: Arena combat with cars. Ramps, a lava pit and pickups (rockets, mines, repair). Each car has health. Last car moving wins the round; best of 3.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Fare Dash
brief: Open-ish city taxi game. Pick up a waiting fare, an arrow points to where they want to go, and every second counts. Near misses and jumps earn tips. Clock gains time with every delivered fare.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Light Trail Arena
brief: Top-down grid arena. Two to four bikes leave solid glowing walls behind them and can only turn at right angles. Hit any wall and you are out. Speed boost pickup; the arena shrinks each round.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Lantern Crawl
brief: First-person wireframe maze seen from eye height. Your lantern lights only the next three cells and burns down as you walk; oil flasks lying in dead ends refill it. Find the exit stair before the light goes out. Each level is a bigger maze with fewer flasks and longer dead ends.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Two Key Doors
brief: Top-down maze for two heroes, PROMPT (cyan) and GLAZE (magenta); TAB swaps which one you control while the other waits. Cyan doors open only for PROMPT and magenta doors only for GLAZE, and floor plates hold a door open while a hero stands on them. Get both heroes to the exit together. Each level adds plates, longer routes and doors that close on a timer.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Echo Rescue
brief: Behind-the-hero view in a dark wire maze. Lost survivors call out; press Space to ping and the walls along the shortest path to the nearest survivor flash for a second. Touch a survivor and they follow you back to the start pad. Each level has more survivors, fewer pings and roaming sentries that send a survivor home if they touch them.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Push Block Vault
brief: Top-down puzzle rooms on a square grid. Push stone blocks onto marked floor tiles to open the vault door; blocks only move when pushed and stop at walls. An undo key takes back one move. Each level is a larger room with more blocks, pits that swallow a block to become floor, and a move limit for a bonus.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Ring Arena
brief: Small round arena seen from above at an angle. Drones spawn at the edge and drift toward you; stand still to charge a shockwave, release it to clear everything inside the ring. Moving cancels the charge. Each wave brings faster drones and a shrinking safe zone.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Stair Hopper
brief: Side-view tower made of floor and ceiling heights. Climb up through the gaps in each floor before the rising water reaches you; ledges that are blue float and drift sideways. Each level is taller, the water faster, and more ledges drift.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Glass Corridors
brief: Behind-the-hero maze where some walls are glass: you can see through them but not walk through. A crystal at the centre is visible from almost everywhere and the route to it is not obvious. A step counter is your score. Each level adds glass, one-way doors and a second crystal.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Bargain Hall
brief: Top-down market hall of small rooms. GLAZE walks between stalls and trades: each stall wants one item and gives another, and you start with one cheap item. Trade up to the gold key that opens the hall door. Each level adds stalls, traders who only trade once, and a clock that closes the market.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Wire Sentries
brief: Top-down maze patrolled by sentries that walk fixed loops and see in a straight line down a corridor. Reach the data cores without being seen; being seen sends you back to the last checkpoint pad. Each level adds sentries, longer sight lines and cores behind them.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Falling Floor
brief: Top-down grid room. Every cell you leave cracks and falls away one second later. Collect every gem and reach the exit without trapping yourself. Each level is a bigger room with walls that block the obvious route and gems in corners.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Tower Shift
brief: Behind-the-hero view on a tower of stacked square rooms. Every 20 seconds the tower turns a quarter and the doors in each room move to new walls. Climb by the stairs to the top room before the next turn traps you. Each level adds floors and makes the turns faster.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Courier Run
brief: Top-down city of narrow alleys made from a maze. PROMPT carries parcels from a depot to doors marked with numbers; the next number is shown at the top of the screen. Dogs chase you in the alleys and must be avoided. Each level adds addresses, dogs and a shorter clock.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Mirror Halls
brief: Top-down maze where PROMPT walks and GLAZE copies every step mirrored left to right in a twin maze beside it. Both must stand on their exit pads at the same time. A wall that stops one hero does not stop the other, which is the whole puzzle. Each level the two mazes differ in more cells.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Switch Room
brief: A single top-down room with coloured floor switches and coloured wall sections. Stepping on a switch raises every wall of its colour and lowers the walls of the other colours. Reach the exit in as few switch presses as you can. Each level adds a colour and a second exit that needs a key from behind a wall.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Beacon Chain
brief: Behind-the-hero view in a large dark wire maze. Unlit beacons stand at crossings; walking past one lights it and lights a line on the floor back to the last lit beacon. Light every beacon to open the exit; the lit lines show where you have been. Each level is a bigger maze with beacons in dead ends.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Pursuit Grid
brief: Top-down grid arena. Three hunters move one cell each time you move one cell, each with its own habit: one chases, one cuts you off, one wanders. Collect the five keys to win the round. Each level makes one hunter take two steps every fourth turn.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Slide Ice Cave
brief: Top-down cave with an ice floor: when you move you slide until a wall or a rock stops you. Reach the exit hole; rough floor patches stop you early. Each level adds rocks, rough patches and a crystal to collect on the way for a bonus.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Lift Shaft
brief: Side view of a building cut open: floors joined by lifts that run on their own up and down. Carry a person from their floor to the floor written above their head, riding lifts and walking corridors. Each level adds floors, lifts that skip floors and more people waiting at once.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Bridge Builder Room
brief: Top-down room split by chasms. Push planks into a chasm to make a bridge one cell wide; a plank pushed into a chasm stays there. Reach the exit with the planks you have. Each level has wider chasms and fewer spare planks.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Sound Maze
brief: First-person wire maze with almost no walls drawn: walls appear as a short flash when you bump into them and stay faintly on the map in the corner. Find the exit by feel and memory. Each level shows less of the map and adds a second floor joined by a ramp.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Guard Swap
brief: Top-down castle maze. PROMPT can knock out a guard from behind; GLAZE can talk a guard into leaving a door for 10 seconds. Get both heroes out of the castle. Each level adds guards who turn around more often and doors that need both tricks.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Orbit Room
brief: A small round room seen from above with the walls slowly turning. Gaps in the turning wall line up with the exit door only now and then. Dodge sparks bouncing off the walls and step through when the gaps line up. Each level adds a second turning ring and more sparks.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Tile Painter
brief: Top-down grid room. Every cell you walk on changes to your colour; cells you walk on twice change back. Paint the whole floor one colour to open the exit. Each level has a bigger room and pillars that make some routes impossible.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Storm Rescue
brief: Behind-the-hero view on a flat island of cells while the sea rises one height step every 30 seconds. Lead stranded villagers up to the hilltop before the low cells flood. Each level has more villagers, a slower climb and bridges that wash away.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Hold The Square
brief: Top-down small square arena; keys: arrows only, no action key. Stand inside the glowing square to fill a bar while drones push in from the four sides; walking into a drone from behind knocks it out of the arena. Fill the bar to win the round. Each round the square moves to a new spot sooner and more drones come.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Wire Ferry
brief: Side view of a river crossed by a ferry on a wire; keys: left and right only. Carry crates from one bank to the other, but the ferry tips if the crates on it are not balanced left and right. Each level adds heavier crates, current that pushes the ferry, and a clock.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Lamp Lighter Run
brief: Behind-the-hero view along a long wire street at night; keys: arrows only, walking past a lamp lights it. Light every lamp before dawn while shadow shapes drift across the street and put out lamps they touch. Each level is a longer street with more shadows.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Signal Relay
brief: Top-down maze; keys: arrows only. PROMPT and GLAZE must stand on two relay pads that can see each other down a straight corridor to pass a signal to the next pair of pads; TAB swaps hero. Reach the last pad pair to finish. Each level has longer chains and pads that only see each other through one-way windows.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Cargo Crawler
brief: Top-down warehouse grid; keys: arrows only, walking into a crate pulls it behind you like a train car. Bring a chain of crates to the loading dock without the chain crossing itself. Each level has more crates, tighter aisles and a forklift that drives a fixed loop.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Spire Climb
brief: Behind-the-hero view climbing a spiral ramp around a tall wire tower; keys: arrows only. Rolling balls come down the ramp; step into the alcoves to let them pass. Reach the top before the clock runs out. Each level is a taller tower with faster balls and fewer alcoves.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Count Room
brief: Top-down room with numbered floor tiles; keys: arrows only. Walk over the tiles in counting order 1, 2, 3 and so on; a wrong tile resets the count to 1. Each level has more tiles, tiles that swap numbers every 10 seconds, and walls that hide the next number.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Rescue Lift
brief: Side view of a mine shaft; keys: up and down only. Lower a cage to miners waiting on ledges and bring them up, but the cage holds three and falling rocks crack it. Each level is a deeper shaft with more miners and more rocks.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Path Painter Duel
brief: Top-down grid arena for PROMPT and a computer GLAZE; keys: arrows only. Each hero colours the cells it walks on; enclosing an area with your colour fills it. The most colour when the clock ends wins. Each level is a bigger arena with walls and a faster rival.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Gate Runner
brief: Behind-the-car view on a wire track; keys: left and right only. Gates of two colours come at you and you can only pass through gates of the colour you are now; passing through a white gate swaps your colour. Each level is faster with closer gates.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Night Garden
brief: Top-down hedge maze; keys: arrows only, walking onto a flower picks it. Pick every flower while a gardener walks the paths with a lantern; standing in its light sends you back to the gate. Each level adds gardeners and flowers in dead ends.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Echo Chamber
brief: First-person round chamber; keys: left and right to turn, up to walk. Targets light up one after another around the wall; face each one within two seconds to score. Each level adds targets, shorter time and a second ring of targets above.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Key Ring Maze
brief: Top-down maze; keys: arrows only. Coloured keys lie in the corridors and coloured locks block some of them; you carry only one key at a time and walking onto another swaps them. Open the way to the exit. Each level adds colours and locks that need a key from the far side of another lock.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Lantern Pair
brief: Behind-the-hero view in a dark maze for PROMPT and GLAZE; keys: arrows, TAB to swap. Only the hero you are not playing holds the lantern, standing still, and its light reaches four cells. Leapfrog through the dark to the exit. Each level has a bigger maze and a weaker lantern.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Sweep Patrol
brief: Top-down room full of dust cells; keys: arrows only. Walk over dust to sweep it while robot vacuums that you must avoid sweep their own loops and leave dust behind them where they turn. Clear the room. Each level adds vacuums and furniture.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Ring Toss Arena
brief: Small round arena seen from above; keys: arrows, and Space to throw. Throw rings onto posts that slide around the floor; a ring on a moving post scores double. Each level has faster posts and fewer rings.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Tunnel Digger
brief: Side view under the ground; keys: arrows only, walking into earth digs it. Dig to the gems while rocks above a dug cell fall after a second. Each level is deeper with more rocks and gems under them.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Fold Map Room
brief: Top-down room drawn on a map that can fold; keys: arrows, and F to fold the left half over the right. Walls on both halves add up when folded, opening or closing paths. Reach the exit. Each level adds a second fold line.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Shadow Tag
brief: Top-down courtyard with pillars; keys: arrows only. You are tagged when the roaming light's beam touches you outside a pillar's shadow; shadows turn as the light circles. Collect the coins. Each level the light circles faster and coins sit in the open.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Twin Lifts
brief: Side view of two lift shafts side by side for PROMPT and GLAZE; keys: arrows, TAB to swap. A lift moves only while its hero stands in it, and the other hero opens the doors on each floor. Bring both to the roof. Each level adds floors and doors that need both heroes.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Pipe Flow Room
brief: Top-down grid of pipe tiles; keys: arrows only, walking onto a tile turns it a quarter. Connect the water from the tank to the drain before the tank overflows. Each level has more tiles, a shorter time and tiles that cannot turn.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Hover Polo
brief: Top-down small pitch; keys: arrows only. Push a puck into the rival goal with your hover craft while one computer craft defends; the puck bounces off the walls. First to five. Each level the rival is faster and the goal smaller.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Sky Stepping
brief: Behind-the-hero view on floating slabs above clouds; keys: arrows only. Slabs sink a little each time you stand on them and fall after three steps. Reach the far tower. Each level has slabs farther apart and slabs that drift.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Market Run
brief: Top-down street market; keys: arrows only, walking into a stall buys from it. Buy the items on your shopping list in the order written before the market closes, without bumping the walking shoppers. Each level has a longer list and more shoppers.
level columns: speed | count | lives | bonus

title: Herd The Sparks
brief: Top-down small arena; keys: arrows only. Loose sparks drift away from you when you come near; steer them into the pen in the corner without letting any touch the electric fence. Each level has more sparks, faster ones and a smaller pen.
level columns: sparks | spark speed | pen size cells | time seconds

title: Relay Doors
brief: Top-down maze for PROMPT and GLAZE; keys: arrows, TAB to swap. Each door is opened by a plate somewhere else, and plates only stay down while a hero stands on them, so the heroes take turns holding doors for each other. Reach the exit together.
level columns: maze size cells | plates | doors | par moves

title: Rolling Stone Hall
brief: Behind-the-hero view down a long hall; keys: arrows only. Stone balls roll toward you; side alcoves are safe, and doors at the far end open only while no ball is rolling. Each level is longer with more balls.
level columns: hall length cells | balls | ball speed | alcoves

title: Crystal Pairs
brief: Top-down room of covered tiles; keys: arrows only, walking onto a tile uncovers it. Uncover two matching crystals in a row to keep them; a mismatch covers both again. Clear the room in few steps.
level columns: pairs | room size cells | par steps

title: Dark Elevator
brief: Side view of a tall building in the dark; keys: up and down only. Ride the lift to the floor whose light blinks, before the light goes out; going past a floor wastes time.
level columns: floors | blink seconds | calls per level

title: Pebble Trail
brief: First-person wire maze; keys: arrows only, and P drops a pebble. Pebbles stay where dropped and show on the floor so you can tell where you have been. Find the exit with the pebbles you have.
level columns: maze size cells | pebbles | par steps

title: Sentinel Ring
brief: Top-down round arena; keys: left and right to circle the edge. A sentinel in the middle turns to face you and fires slow pulses; pickups appear on the ring. Collect them without being hit.
level columns: pickups | pulse speed | pulses at once | sentinel turn speed

title: Bucket Line
brief: Side view of a burning house and a well; keys: left and right only. Carry water from the well to the fires, each trip putting one out, while new fires start.
level columns: fires at start | new fire seconds | carry speed | house width cells

title: Echo Steps
brief: Top-down dark room; keys: arrows only. Each step lights the floor around you for a moment and shows walls within two cells; a ghost copy of you replays your last ten steps and touching it sends you back. Reach the exit.
level columns: room size cells | ghost delay steps | par steps

title: Lockstep Bridge
brief: Side view of two bridges, PROMPT on the top one and GLAZE on the lower; keys: left and right move both at once. Gaps on either bridge must be crossed when the other hero is on solid ground.
level columns: bridge length cells | gaps | moving gaps

title: Mirror Shots
brief: Top-down room with angled mirrors; keys: arrows, and Space to fire a light beam ahead. Walking into a mirror turns it. Light the target by bouncing the beam.
level columns: mirrors | turnable mirrors | targets | par shots

title: Dropping Rooms
brief: Behind-the-hero view in a tower of rooms stacked straight down; keys: arrows only. Each room's floor has a hole that moves; fall through it to the next room before the room fills with smoke.
level columns: rooms | hole speed | smoke seconds

title: Rope Swing Gap
brief: Side view of a cave of ledges; keys: left, right, and up to grab a rope. Swing from rope to rope over the pits and let go at the top of the swing to land on the next ledge. Missing the ledge drops you back to the last one.
level columns: ropes (3 to 8) | gap cells (2 to 5) | rope swing seconds (2.0 down to 1.2)

title: Snow Plough Maze
brief: Top-down town of streets under snow; keys: arrows only. Driving the plough clears a street cell; snow falls back on cleared cells after a while. Clear the route from the hospital to every house.
level columns: houses (2 to 6) | town size cells (8 to 16) | snow return seconds (40 down to 15)

title: Twin Keys Vault
brief: Top-down vault for PROMPT and GLAZE; keys: arrows, TAB to swap. The vault door has two locks that must be turned in the same second: one hero stands at each lock and you swap fast. Guards walk between them.
level columns: guards (0 to 4) | lock distance cells (4 to 12) | swap seconds allowed (3 down to 1)

title: Glow Worm Cave
brief: First-person dark cave; keys: arrows only. Glow worms on the walls light up for a few seconds when you pass; their light shows the way back. Find the three crystals and return to the entrance.
level columns: cave size cells (7 to 15) | glow seconds (8 down to 3) | crystals (3 to 5)

title: Ball Gate Arena
brief: Top-down small arena with four gates; keys: arrows only, walking into the ball pushes it. Push the ball through the gate that is lit; the lit gate changes after each goal and drones get in the way.
level columns: goals to win (3 to 7) | drones (0 to 4) | drone speed (0.8 to 2.0)

title: Fuse Runner
brief: Behind-the-hero view along a wire corridor; keys: arrows only. A lit fuse burns along the floor behind you; reach each switch to cut it before it catches you, then a new fuse starts.
level columns: switches (3 to 7) | fuse speed (1.0 to 1.8) | corridor cells per switch (6 to 12)

title: Hidden Floor
brief: Top-down room of plain tiles; keys: arrows only. Some tiles are holes you cannot see; stepping on a safe tile shows the number of holes next to it. Reach the exit; a hole sends you back to the start and shows itself.
level columns: room size cells (5 to 10) | holes (4 to 20) | par steps

title: Kite Field
brief: Side view of a windy field; keys: left and right to walk, up and down to pull the line. Keep your kite in the air and fly it through hoops while birds cross the sky.
level columns: hoops (3 to 8) | wind gust seconds (6 down to 2) | birds (0 to 5)

title: Conveyor Sort
brief: Top-down factory; keys: arrows only, walking onto a junction flips it. Boxes of three colours ride the conveyors; flip the junctions so each box reaches the bin of its colour.
level columns: junctions (2 to 6) | boxes per minute (10 to 30) | colours (2 to 4)

title: Sleepwalker Guide
brief: Top-down house at night; keys: arrows only. A sleepwalker walks straight ahead and turns right at walls; place yourself in the way to turn them and lead them back to bed, away from the stairs.
level columns: rooms (2 to 6) | sleepwalker speed (0.5 to 1.2) | stair holes (1 to 4)

title: Signal Flags
brief: Top-down harbour; keys: arrows only. Ships come in showing a flag colour; run along the quay to the berth of the same colour and wave them in by standing on its marker.
level columns: berths (3 to 6) | ships at once (1 to 4) | ship speed (0.5 to 1.5)

title: Star Weaver
brief: First-person under a dome of stars; keys: arrows to turn and tilt. Look from star to star to draw lines between them and trace the shape shown in the corner.
level columns: stars in shape (4 to 10) | extra stars (5 to 30) | seconds per shape (40 down to 20)

title: Tide Pool Hop
brief: Top-down rocky shore; keys: arrows only. Hop from rock to rock to reach the shells before the tide covers the low rocks; covered rocks return when the tide goes out.
level columns: shells (3 to 8) | tide seconds (30 down to 12) | low rocks share percent (20 to 50)

title: Cable Car Rescue
brief: Side view of a mountain with cable cars; keys: left and right to run the winch, up to open the doors. Bring stranded hikers down from the stations without letting two cars meet on the same span.
level columns: stations (2 to 5) | cars (1 to 3) | hikers (2 to 8)

title: Patrol Swap
brief: Top-down prison yard maze for PROMPT and GLAZE; keys: arrows, TAB to swap. A searchlight follows whichever hero moved last, so the other can slip past while you draw it away. Both reach the gate.
level columns: maze size cells (9 to 15) | searchlights (1 to 3) | light speed (0.8 to 1.6)

title: Counterweight Room
brief: Side view of a room with pulleys; keys: arrows only, walking into a crate pushes it. Platforms on ropes go up when the other end is heavier; push crates onto platforms to lift yourself to the exit.
level columns: pulleys (1 to 4) | crates (2 to 6) | par moves (10 to 40)

title: Lighthouse Keeper
brief: First-person inside a round lighthouse lamp room; keys: left and right to turn the lamp. Ships approach rocks from all sides; keep each ship in the beam long enough to steer it clear.
level columns: ships at once (1 to 4) | seconds to warn (6 down to 3) | ship speed (0.5 to 1.5)

title: Gravity Rooms
brief: Side view of small square rooms; keys: left, right, and up to flip gravity. Flipping drops you to the ceiling; spikes on floor and ceiling end a try. Reach the door of each room.
level columns: rooms (3 to 8) | spike cells per room (2 to 10) | moving spikes (0 to 3)

title: Recycling Robot
brief: Top-down street; keys: arrows only, walking into litter picks it up (carry up to three). Drop litter in the bin of its kind by walking into the bin; wind blows new litter in.
level columns: litter at start (5 to 15) | carry limit (3 down to 2) | wind seconds (20 down to 8)

title: Firefly Jar
brief: Top-down meadow at night; keys: arrows only. Fireflies blink on and off; walk into one while it is lit to catch it, and dark ones cannot be caught.
level columns: fireflies (5 to 15) | lit seconds (3 down to 1) | meadow size cells (8 to 16)

title: Train Yard Switch
brief: Top-down rail yard; keys: arrows only, walking onto a switch flips it. Steer each train into the siding of its colour before the next one arrives; two trains on one track end the try.
level columns: sidings (2 to 5) | trains (3 to 10) | train speed (0.6 to 1.4)

title: Dust Devil Chase
brief: Top-down desert; keys: arrows only. Small whirlwinds wander and pick up anything they touch; chase them down to get back the stolen gems before they leave the map edge.
level columns: whirlwinds (1 to 5) | gems (3 to 8) | whirlwind speed (0.6 to 1.5)

title: Clock Tower Climb
brief: Side view inside a clock tower; keys: left, right, and up to jump. The giant gears turn and their teeth are platforms; ride them up to the bell.
level columns: gears (3 to 8) | gear speed (0.5 to 1.5) | height cells (12 to 30)

title: Paper Plane Post
brief: Side view over rooftops; keys: up and down to steer a paper plane gliding right. Fly letters through the open windows marked on the houses; the wind lifts over chimneys.
